when.quote: When a customer needs to file a formal dispute for a credit card transaction (such as unauthorized charges, merchant issues, or billing errors), the agent must gather comprehensive information and call the file_credit_card_transaction_dispute_4829 tool.

starts.note: customer: start only when the customer asks to dispute a credit card charge. Never file a dispute the customer did not ask for. Order a replacement card only if the customer asks for the card to be cancelled and replaced. Provisional credit is never a separate action. It is decided for each dispute and passed in that dispute's eligible_for_provisional_credit flag. If the customer also asked for something else in the same conversation, handle the requests in the order the customer gave them, and verify only once. One exception: the customer also asked for a credit limit increase on the same card, and it has not been decided yet. Then first tell them that an active dispute (and a pending replacement) would block the increase. Offer to do the increase first (cli_conflict_notice), then follow the order the customer chooses.
starts.quote: However, if you've already tried contacting the merchant without success, or if the charge appears to be fraudulent, please don't hesitate to reach out to us right away.

tools.not_used: Not used in this job. Provisional credit is recorded only through the dispute's eligible_for_provisional_credit flag. No dispute document says to post a statement credit when a dispute is filed. This tool is for goodwill credits, fee reversals and similar adjustments, and for credits after a dispute is resolved.

steps.do: Decide eligible_for_provisional_credit using the Provisional Credit Eligibility Guidelines. Every criterion must hold: (1) The account has been open at least 60 days (open date from get_accounts compared with get_time). (2) The reason is unauthorized_fraudulent_charge or duplicate_charge, or it is goods_services_not_received with the purchase made more than 30 days ago. (3) The amount is at least $25.00 and no more than the maximum for the tier of the card the transaction is on. (4) No more than 2 disputes in the past 12 months (check_dispute_history, or running_dispute_count when several disputes are filed). (5) For a reason other than fraud, the merchant was contacted. If any criterion fails, set it to false.
steps.quote: 15. eligible_for_provisional_credit (boolean) - Agent must determine this based on the Provisional Credit Eligibility Guidelines article in this knowledge base. Pass true or false.

rules.rule: Provisional credit is true only if ALL of these hold: (1) the account has been open at least 60 days; (2) the reason is unauthorized_fraudulent_charge or duplicate_charge, or it is goods_services_not_received with the purchase made more than 30 days ago; (3) the amount is at least $25.00 and no more than the tier maximum; (4) no more than 2 disputes in the past 12 months; (5) for a non-fraud dispute, the merchant was contacted first
rules.quote: ## Eligibility Criteria — Customer is ELIGIBLE for provisional credit if ALL of the following are true:

rules.rule: The reasons incorrect_amount, goods_services_not_as_described, canceled_subscription_still_charging and refund_never_processed are never eligible for provisional credit
rules.quote: - Dispute reason is 'incorrect_amount', 'goods_services_not_as_described', 'canceled_subscription_still_charging', or 'refund_never_processed'

rules.quote: 5. Contacted Merchant: For non-fraud disputes (anything other than 'unauthorized_fraudulent_charge'), the customer must have attempted to resolve with the merchant first

rules.rule: Ordering a replacement cancels the old card automatically, so order one only when the customer wants the card replaced
rules.quote: The old card is automatically cancelled for security and will no longer work for new purchases.

rules.rule: The dispute's address argument is the registered home address from the records, never a shipping address the customer gives for a replacement card
rules.quote: 8. address (string) - The registered home address of the user.

rules.rule: A charge that appears more than once is a duplicate_charge
rules.quote: 'duplicate_charge': Same charge appeared multiple times

rules.rule: Do not order a replacement unless the eligibility check (pending orders, tier limit) passes
rules.quote: Confirm eligibility for replacement in the knowledge base before proceeding. Do not unlock or call the tool unless the customer is eligible.

rules.rule: Each dispute uses the last 4 digits and tier of the card its own transaction was made on
rules.quote: Last 4 digits of the credit card under which the disputed transaction took place.

rules.rule: An active dispute blocks a credit limit increase on the same account. If the customer also wants an increase that is not yet decided, tell them before filing and offer to do the increase first.
rules.quote: 3. No Pending Disputes: Verify the account has no active disputes.

rules.rule: Verify identity once per conversation; a later job in the same conversation reuses the verified user
rules.quote: No need to verify more than once in a single conversation.

rules.rule: A transfer after a failed filing uses a listed reason code: fraud_or_security_concern for unauthorized or fraudulent charges, otherwise technical_system_error
rules.quote: | fraud_or_security_concern | Fraud, identity theft, unauthorized transactions, or security concerns requiring specialist handling |

rules.rule: If the dispute history read fails or returns partial data, retry it; if it still fails, escalate rather than guess the prior-dispute count
rules.quote: If the issue persists, capture the request context and escalate through internal support channels.

done_when: All of the following hold. The customer is verified and the verification is logged (once per conversation). If the customer also wanted a credit limit increase on the same card that was not yet decided, they were told before filing that the dispute would block it, and the order they chose was followed. file_credit_card_transaction_dispute_4829 has been called successfully once for each confirmed transaction in the records, on every card involved, with all required arguments. Each call carries that card's last 4 digits and the card_action for that card (cancel_and_reissue for a card already replaced in this conversation or being replaced). Each call also carries an eligible_for_provisional_credit value decided for that dispute. When several disputes are filed, that value uses the running dispute count and the order set by the customer's priorities: the disputes they named first, then the rest of the room per priority_rest_of_room, largest first if they asked. If the customer chose cancel_and_reissue and was eligible, a replacement was ordered (once only). Charges not found in the records were explained and not disputed. The customer has been told that each dispute is filed and whether provisional credit applies. If filing or the history read failed, the failure has been explained instead and a transfer offered. If the customer raised another request, the agent has moved on to that job without verifying again.
